# Syncopx

Syncopx is a free, autonomous agentic desktop AI assistant for Windows 10/11 64-bit.
It decomposes multi-step goals into autonomous subagents with persistent disk sessions,
talks and listens (continuous voice with barge-in interruption), sees the screen (OCR + control),
generates programs and scheduled background tasks, executes terminal commands with inline cards & diff drawers,
provides a token-authenticated Remote Access & Automation REST API, and tracks live token/cost and per-chat time.

- Download (1.5.1 ZIP, no admin, no signup): https://syncopx.vercel.app/#download
- How installing works: https://syncopx.vercel.app/#install
- AI providers (bring your own key, or 100% offline with local Ollama): https://syncopx.vercel.app/#providers
- FAQ: https://syncopx.vercel.app/#faq
- Terms: https://syncopx.vercel.app/terms.html
- Privacy: https://syncopx.vercel.app/privacy.html
- Current version metadata (v1.5.1, size, SHA-256): https://syncopx.vercel.app/downloads/version.json

API keys are encrypted on the user's PC with Windows DPAPI. Zero accounts, zero tracking, no bundled keys.
Safety Profiles (Safe, Balanced, Unleashed) with allowedDirs scoping and fail-closed headless security.
Built-in in-app auto-updating directly from Settings -> Check for Updates.
